title: CompTIA A+ Core
content_provenance: Original practice items authored from the public CompTIA A+ exam objectives. Not a capture of past exam questions.

items.stem: A technician needs to connect a Bluetooth headset to a laptop that lacks a built-in Bluetooth adapter. What is the most appropriate solution?
items.explanation: A USB Bluetooth adapter provides wireless Bluetooth connectivity for devices that do not have it integrated.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: Which type of mobile device display uses organic compounds that emit light when electrified, offering better contrast and power efficiency?
items.explanation: OLED displays use organic light-emitting diodes to produce images with deep blacks and low power consumption.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: A user reports intermittent Wi-Fi drops. The technician notices the device connects to a distant access point instead of a closer one. What setting could help resolve this issue?
options: Enable band steering or adjust roaming sensitivity
items.explanation: Adjusting roaming thresholds helps devices switch to stronger access points when moving through coverage areas.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: Which cellular technology provides the highest theoretical data speeds among current mainstream mobile standards?
items.explanation: 5G cellular networks offer significantly higher bandwidth and lower latency than previous generations.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: A technician is configuring a wireless network. Which characteristic best describes the 2.4 GHz band compared to 5 GHz?
options: Longer range and better wall penetration
items.explanation: The 2.4 GHz band has longer wavelengths, allowing better wall penetration and greater range than 5 GHz.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: Which mobile device synchronization method allows changes to propagate between a device and a server over the internet in near real time?
items.explanation: Cloud synchronization services automatically update data across devices when connected to the internet.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: A technician notices a laptop cannot obtain an IP address on a network using DHCP. Which is the most likely cause?
options: The subnet mask is configured statically
The DHCP server is unreachable or not responding
items.explanation: If a DHCP server is down or unreachable, clients cannot obtain IP addresses automatically.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: Which networking protocol translates human-readable domain names into IP addresses?
items.explanation: DNS resolves domain names to IP addresses so clients can connect to network resources.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: A user wants to protect sensitive data on a lost or stolen mobile device. Which feature should be configured in advance?
items.explanation: Remote wipe allows data to be erased from a lost or stolen device to prevent unauthorized access.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: Which type of network cable is typically used to connect two computers directly without a switch?
items.explanation: A crossover cable swaps transmit and receive pairs to allow direct device-to-device Ethernet connections.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: What is the primary purpose of a mobile device VPN when connected to public Wi-Fi?
options: To encrypt network traffic and protect data in transit
items.explanation: VPNs create an encrypted tunnel that protects sensitive traffic on untrusted public networks.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: Which wireless technology is best suited for very short-range payments and data exchange between nearby devices?
items.explanation: NFC supports very short-range communication commonly used for contactless payments and pairing.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: A laptop set to obtain an IP address automatically shows 169.254.x.x. What does this indicate?
options: APIPA assignment due to DHCP failure
items.explanation: APIPA assigns 169.254 addresses when a DHCP server cannot be reached by the client.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: Which component in a mobile device stores the operating system and user data persistently?
items.explanation: Non-volatile flash storage retains the OS, apps, and user data when power is removed.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: When troubleshooting slow Wi-Fi speeds, which factor most commonly reduces throughput on a wireless network?
options: High channel congestion from nearby networks
items.explanation: Channel congestion from nearby networks causes interference and reduces Wi-Fi throughput.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Mobile Devices and Networking

items.stem: Which type of RAM is most commonly used in modern desktop computers for main system memory?
items.explanation: DDR4 SDRAM is widely used in current desktop and laptop systems due to its speed and capacity improvements.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: A technician needs to install additional storage in a laptop with no 2.5 inch bay available. What is the most appropriate option?
items.explanation: M.2 NVMe SSDs are compact and common in modern laptops where space for traditional drives is limited.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: Which hardware component is responsible for converting AC power from a wall outlet to DC power for a computer?
items.explanation: The PSU converts alternating current to the direct current voltages needed by computer components.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: A technician is building a PC and needs to ensure proper cooling for the CPU. Which of the following is most effective?
options: Leaving the CPU exposed to air
Wrapping the CPU in insulating tape
A heatsink with a thermal paste and fan
items.explanation: A heatsink combined with thermal paste and an active fan dissipates heat effectively from the CPU.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: Which type of printer uses a laser beam to create an electrostatic image on a drum before transferring toner to paper?
items.explanation: Laser printers use electrophotographic processes involving a laser, drum, toner, and fuser unit.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: A user reports that their computer will not power on at all. What should be the first troubleshooting step for a technician?
options: Verify power source and cable connections
items.explanation: Checking the power source, outlet, cables, and PSU connections is the logical first step for no-power issues.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: Which virtual machine feature allows a VM to run with minimal performance overhead by accessing hardware directly?
items.explanation: Intel VT-x and AMD-V provide CPU extensions that enable efficient hardware-assisted virtualization.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: Which storage interface provides the fastest data transfer speeds for modern internal solid state drives?
items.explanation: PCIe NVMe interfaces offer significantly higher throughput compared to SATA-based SSDs.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: A technician needs to replace a laptop battery. What safety precaution should be taken first?
options: Pour water on the battery to cool it
Use metal tools to pry it open
Power off the laptop and unplug it from AC power
items.explanation: Always disconnect power sources before servicing batteries to prevent electrical hazards.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: Which motherboard form factor is commonly used in compact desktop systems with limited space?
items.explanation: Micro-ATX boards are smaller than standard ATX while still providing essential expansion slots.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: What is the purpose of a hypervisor in a virtualization environment?
options: To manage and allocate hardware resources to virtual machines
items.explanation: A hypervisor creates and runs VMs by abstracting physical hardware and allocating resources.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: Which type of expansion card would a technician install to provide additional video output capabilities?
items.explanation: A dedicated GPU accelerates graphics rendering and provides multiple display outputs.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: A laser printer is producing faded printouts. Which component is most likely the cause and needs replacement?
items.explanation: Low toner levels in the cartridge typically result in faded or light print quality on laser printers.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: Which of the following is a benefit of using solid state drives compared to traditional hard disk drives?
options: Faster boot times and no moving parts
Higher mechanical durability from spinning disks
Lower cost per GB for all capacities
Better data recovery from physical damage
items.explanation: SSDs have no moving parts, resulting in faster access times, lower power consumption, and greater shock resistance.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: What type of virtualization allows running multiple operating systems on a single physical host simultaneously?
items.explanation: Full virtualization enables multiple guest OSes to run independently on the same hardware via a hypervisor.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Hardware and Virtualization

items.stem: Which Windows utility is commonly used to view and manage running processes and system performance?
items.explanation: Task Manager allows users to monitor and control running processes, applications, and system resource usage.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: A user needs to recover a deleted file from the Recycle Bin in Windows. Which action is correct?
options: Cut and paste to root directory
Right-click the file and select Restore
items.explanation: Restoring from the Recycle Bin returns the file to its original location.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: Which file system is natively supported by modern Windows versions for internal drives and supports large file sizes with permissions?
items.explanation: NTFS provides security permissions, encryption support, and large volume capabilities.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: Which Linux command displays the contents of a directory including hidden files?
items.explanation: The ls -la command lists all files with detailed information including hidden entries.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: A technician needs to create a strong password policy for users. Which of the following is the best practice?
options: Use the same password for all accounts
Require a mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters with minimum length
items.explanation: Strong passwords combine character types and sufficient length to resist brute force attacks.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: Which Windows feature allows users to run applications in an isolated environment for testing?
items.explanation: Windows Sandbox provides a temporary isolated desktop environment for safely running untrusted software.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: A user receives a suspicious email requesting login credentials. What type of attack is this?
items.explanation: Phishing attempts to trick users into disclosing sensitive information through fraudulent messages.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: Which mobile operating system feature encrypts user data by default on modern devices?
items.explanation: Modern mobile OSes provide encryption to protect data if the device is lost or stolen.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: Which command in Windows is used to check and repair disk errors?
items.explanation: The chkdsk utility scans for and attempts to fix filesystem errors on a disk.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: A technician needs to secure a workstation by preventing unauthorized physical access. Which is the most basic measure?
options: Use a strong login password and lock the screen when unattended
items.explanation: Locking the workstation and using authentication prevents unauthorized local access.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: Which type of malware encrypts a users files and demands payment for decryption?
items.explanation: Ransomware holds data hostage by encrypting files until a ransom is paid.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: Which Windows tool allows a user to configure automatic updates and security settings?
items.explanation: The Windows Update & Security section manages patching, antivirus, and security features.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: A user wants to prevent others from accessing their files on a shared computer. What is the best approach?
options: Name files with a secret code
Set NTFS permissions on the files/folders
Hide files in a temp folder
items.explanation: NTFS permissions allow granular access control for files and directories.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: Which macOS feature provides disk encryption for the entire startup disk?
items.explanation: FileVault encrypts the startup disk to protect data from unauthorized access.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: Which security practice involves verifying a users identity using multiple factors like password and a code?
items.explanation: MFA requires two or more authentication factors, significantly improving account security.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Operating Systems and Security

items.stem: A technician is troubleshooting a PC that boots to a blue screen. What is the most systematic first step?
options: Document the error code and search for known causes
items.explanation: Documenting the stop code helps identify the root cause and appropriate remediation steps.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: When replacing a component in a computer, which safety procedure should be followed first?
options: Work while powered on for testing
Disconnect power and follow ESD precautions
items.explanation: ESD precautions and power disconnection prevent electrical damage and personal injury.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: A user reports slow performance on their computer. Which step should a technician take first?
options: Install every available update at once
Identify recent changes and check resource usage
items.explanation: Checking recent changes, CPU, memory, and disk usage helps pinpoint performance bottlenecks.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: Which documentation should a technician complete after resolving a service ticket?
options: Record the solution, time, and any follow-up needed
items.explanation: Proper ticket documentation ensures knowledge sharing and accountability.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: A printer is displaying a paper jam error but no paper is visible. What should the technician do next?
options: Force the paper tray closed harder
Check hidden areas like the rear access door and rollers
items.explanation: Paper can be jammed in internal pathways not visible from the front of the printer.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: A user complains that their laptop battery drains quickly. Which is the best initial troubleshooting step?
options: Check battery health and power settings
items.explanation: Assessing battery health and adjusting power settings identifies common causes of rapid drain.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: Which of the following is the proper order for troubleshooting methodology?
options: Identify the problem, establish theory, test theory, plan action, verify, document
items.explanation: A structured troubleshooting methodology ensures efficient and repeatable problem resolution.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: A technician needs to dispose of old lithium-ion batteries. What is the correct procedure?
options: Follow local regulations for hazardous waste recycling
items.explanation: Lithium-ion batteries are hazardous and must be recycled or disposed of per regulations.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: A computer intermittently loses network connectivity. Which tool would best help diagnose the issue?
items.explanation: Network diagnostic commands help identify connectivity and routing issues.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: Which action demonstrates proper communication with a customer during troubleshooting?
options: Blame the user for the issue
Ask clarifying questions and explain steps in simple terms
items.explanation: Clear, respectful communication builds trust and ensures user cooperation.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: A technician is preparing to work on a server rack. What safety equipment or practice is important?
options: Work alone in a dark room
Use proper lifting techniques and anti-static precautions
items.explanation: Server equipment can be heavy and sensitive; proper safety practices prevent injury and damage.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: A user cannot access a specific website but can access others. What is the most likely cause to investigate first?
options: DNS resolution or hosts file issue
items.explanation: If only one site fails, DNS or local hosts file entries are common culprits.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: Which Windows command clears the local DNS cache?
items.explanation: Flushing DNS cache resolves stale or incorrect DNS entries.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: A mobile device will not charge when connected to a known-good charger. What should be checked first?
options: Inspect the charging port for debris or damage
items.explanation: Debris or physical damage in the port often prevents proper charging contact.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures

items.stem: After installing new RAM, a PC fails to boot and emits beep codes. What does this indicate?
items.explanation: Beep codes during POST typically signal hardware-related problems like memory issues.
items.reference: CompTIA A+ Exam Objectives - Troubleshooting and Procedures
